nodes.description: mapping(address=>uint256) private _onSaleNum counting how many times an address has sold/transferred
mapping(address=>bool) private canSale whitelist bypassing the sale conditions
uint256 private _minSale minimum amount allowed per transfer
uint256 private _maxSale maximum amount allowed per transfer
uint256 private _saleNum number of allowed sales per address
address tradeAddress privileged address exempt from ensure() checks
public mapping(address=>uint) balanceOf holding token balances
public mapping(address=>mapping(address=>uint)) allowance holding spending approvals
uint public totalSupply of the token
address private owner, single privileged account controlling admin functions
public payable transfer(address _to, uint _value) that forwards to transferFrom(msg.sender,_to,_value)
internal view ensure(address _from,address _to,uint _value) whitelist gate using owner/UNI/tradeAddress/canSale then condition()
public payable transferFrom(address _from,address _to,uint _value) applying allowance, ensure() and raw mapping balance arithmetic
public payable approve(address _spender,uint _value) writing allowance[msg.sender][_spender]
internal view condition(address _from,uint _value) enforcing _saleNum/_minSale/_maxSale/_onSaleNum limits
public payable delegate(address a, bytes memory b) performing an owner-gated delegatecall into caller-supplied target
owner-only init(uint256 saleNum,uint256 token,uint256 maxToken) setting sale limits
owner-only batchSend(address[] _tos,uint _value) looping and mutating balances of many recipients
setTradeAddress(address addr) owner-only writes tradeAddress used to bypass ensure()
internal pure pairFor(address factory,address tokenA,address tokenB) computing the Uniswap pair address
payable constructor(string _name,string _symbol,uint256 _supply) setting owner, supply, balances and infinite allowance
msg.sender, the externally controlled caller used for ownership checks, allowance keys and token holder identity
a.delegatecall(b) low-level delegatecall to an arbitrary address supplied by the owner
balanceOf[_from] -= _value unchecked mapping subtraction (no SafeMath) in transferFrom
balanceOf[_to] += _value unchecked mapping addition in transferFrom
total = _value * _tos.length unchecked multiplication in batchSend

parameter _value of transfer()

parameter _value of transferFrom()

parameter _value of approve()
parameter a, the delegatecall target address in delegate()
parameter b, the calldata payload passed to delegatecall in delegate()
parameter saleNum of init()
parameter token (min sale) of init()
parameter maxToken (max sale) of init()
parameter _tos recipient array of batchSend()
parameter _value per-recipient amount of batchSend()
parameter addr of setTradeAddress()
parameter _from of ensure()
parameter _to of ensure()
parameter _value of ensure()

local loop variable address _to in batchSend()
local variable _UNI computed pair address in ensure()

edges.reason: transferFrom reads balanceOf[_from] and balanceOf[_to] before mutating them
transferFrom writes the balanceOf mapping for sender and recipient
transferFrom reads allowance[_from][msg.sender] to validate spend
transferFrom decreases the allowance mapping
transferFrom increments _onSaleNum[_from] and thereby the anti-dump counter
condition reads _onSaleNum[_from] to enforce per-address sale count
condition reads _minSale to bound the transfer amount
condition reads _maxSale to bound the transfer amount
condition reads _saleNum to enforce the global sale count
init writes the _minSale state variable
init writes the _maxSale state variable
init writes the _saleNum state variable
ensure reads the canSale whitelist to bypass conditions
ensure reads tradeAddress as a privileged transfer bypass
ensure grants an unconditional bypass when _from or _to equals owner
setTradeAddress writes tradeAddress, an address that bypasses ensure()
approve writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender]
batchSend reads balanceOf[msg.sender] to verify sufficient funds
batchSend mutates balanceOf for the sender and every recipient in the loop
constructor assigns owner = msg.sender, minting the sole privilege
constructor sets totalSupply and mints it to msg.sender
transfer uses msg.sender as the _from account in its call to transferFrom
approve uses msg.sender as the allowance owner key
constructor takes ownership from msg.sender and grants an unlimited UNI allowance
transferFrom branches on msg.sender != _from to decide whether allowance must be consumed
init requires msg.sender == owner before changing sale parameters
batchSend requires msg.sender == owner before mass balance mutation
setTradeAddress requires msg.sender == owner before setting the bypass address
delegate requires msg.sender == owner before executing arbitrary delegatecall
the delegatecall unsafe operation is guarded only by msg.sender == owner
transfer delegates execution to transferFrom
transferFrom calls ensure for the whitelist/sale condition gate
ensure calls pairFor to compute the Uniswap pair address
ensure calls condition to enforce _minSale/_maxSale/_saleNum limits
delegate executes the low-level delegatecall unsafe operation
transferFrom performs an unchecked balanceOf[_from] -= _value that underflows without SafeMath
transferFrom performs an unchecked balanceOf[_to] += _value that can overflow without SafeMath
batchSend computes total = _value * _tos.length with unchecked multiplication
parameter _to flows into transfer as the transfer recipient
parameter _value flows into transfer and onward to transferFrom
parameter _from flows into transferFrom as the debited account
parameter _to flows into transferFrom as the credited account
parameter _value flows into transferFrom arithmetic and ensure checks
parameter _spender flows into approve as the allowance key
parameter _value flows into approve as the allowance amount
parameter a flows into delegate as the delegatecall target
parameter b is the calldata passed to the delegatecall unsafe operation
parameter saleNum flows into init and is stored in _saleNum
parameter token flows into init and becomes _minSale
parameter maxToken flows into init and becomes _maxSale
parameter _tos is iterated by batchSend to select recipients
parameter _value is multiplied and credited inside batchSend
parameter addr is written into tradeAddress by setTradeAddress
parameter _from of ensure feeds the owner/whitelist and condition checks
parameter _to of ensure feeds the owner and UNI whitelist checks
parameter _value of ensure feeds the condition amount checks
local total holds the result of the unchecked multiplication in batchSend
loop-local _to is the batchSend recipient credited each iteration
local _UNI is the computed pair address compared in ensure
arbitrary delegatecall payload b supplied by the owner can re-enter UniswapExchange during the delegate execution

Incoming amount argument of transfer; forwarded to transferFrom and carries no standalone state.
Debited account argument whose dataflow terminates in transferFrom state writes.
Credited account argument used only within transferFrom and ensure.
Amount argument driving allowance, ensure and balance arithmetic in transferFrom.
Spender argument used solely as the allowance mapping key in approve.
Amount argument stored by approve; has no independent semantic role.
Target address argument consumed by the delegate function call.
Raw calldata argument is passed directly into the delegatecall unsafe operation.
Configuration argument consumed by the owner-only init function.
Minimum-sale configuration argument consumed by init.
Maximum-sale configuration argument consumed by init.
Recipient array argument iterated by the owner-only batchSend loop.
Per-recipient amount argument consumed by batchSend arithmetic.
Address argument directly assigned to tradeAddress by the setter.
Account argument feeding the whitelist and sale-condition gate in ensure.
Recipient argument checked against owner/UNI whitelist inside ensure.
Amount argument forwarded from ensure into condition limits.
Temporary variable that stores the unchecked multiplication result of batchSend.
Loop-scoped recipient variable used only inside the batchSend iteration.
Temporary pair address computed and compared only inside ensure.
